blockedIdentities.reason: WOLF is used by multiple unrelated current manufacturers, and the queue record does not contain enough scope information to identify one manufacturer-owned source without risking a false match.
AEG is a broad licensed and legacy brand used across several present-day product businesses; the raw record does not identify the intended legal manufacturer or industrial product scope.
RODON matches several unrelated industrial companies and product brands. No queue evidence distinguishes the intended entity strongly enough for publication.
ITEC is a generic acronym used by multiple manufacturers in different industrial sectors; no canonical product scope or independent identity signal is present in the queue record.
MEZ BRNO is associated with several current successor and related motor businesses. The raw identity does not establish which current manufacturer entity should own the canonical page.
STI is used by multiple unrelated industrial manufacturers, including safety, transport and process-equipment businesses. The queue record lacks a product or geography discriminator.
SUPERVAC corresponds to separate manufacturers of vacuum packaging machinery, ventilation equipment and vacuum systems. A canonical match cannot be made from the raw name alone.

The Bockwoldt geared-motor identity is plausible, but its manufacturer-owned website could not be reached or verified during this pass. Distributor-hosted catalogs were not accepted as primary evidence.

The Kromschröder identity, Honeywell ownership and combustion-control scope duplicate the existing canonical elster-kromschroeder profile. A second indexable profile would split one current brand identity.
